mapper.select: SELECT p.production_order_no AS productionOrderNo, p.assembly_order_quantity AS assemblyOrderQuantity, p.assembly_material_no AS assemblyMaterialNo, p.main_material_desc AS mainMaterialDesc, p.base_completion_date AS baseCompletionDate, p.production_workshop AS productionWorkshop, p.order_create_time AS orderCreateTime, p.scheduled_quantity AS scheduledQuantity, p.SCHEDULED_DATE as scheduleddate, COALESCE(t.workshop_output, 0) AS workshopOutput, p.scheduled_quantity - COALESCE(t.workshop_output, 0) AS difference FROM aps_main_plan p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_no, material_code, SUM(quantity) AS workshop_output FROM buyer_production_transfer WHERE deleted = '0' AND TO_CHAR(INITIATOR_DATE,'YYYY-MM') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY-MM') GROUP BY order_no, material_code ) t ON p.production_order_no = LTRIM(t.order_no, '0') AND p.assembly_material_no = t.material_code WHERE p.deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.production_order_no, p.assembly_material_no

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aps_main_plan p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_no, material_code, SUM(quantity) AS workshop_output FROM buyer_production_transfer WHERE deleted = '0' GROUP BY order_no, material_code ) t ON p.production_order_no = LTRIM(t.order_no, '0') AND p.assembly_material_no = t.material_code

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT t.*, ROWNUM AS rn FROM ( SELECT p.production_order_no AS productionOrderNo, p.assembly_order_quantity AS assemblyOrderQuantity, p.assembly_material_no AS assemblyMaterialNo, p.main_material_desc AS mainMaterialDesc, p.base_completion_date AS baseCompletionDate, p.production_workshop AS productionWorkshop, p.order_create_time AS orderCreateTime, p.scheduled_quantity AS scheduledQuantity, p.scheduled_date AS scheduledDate, COALESCE(t.workshop_output, 0) AS workshopOutput, p.scheduled_quantity - COALESCE(t.workshop_output, 0) AS difference FROM aps_main_plan p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_no, material_code, SUM(quantity) AS workshop_output FROM buyer_production_transfer WHERE deleted = '0' GROUP BY order_no, material_code ) t ON p.production_order_no = LTRIM(t.order_no, '0') AND p.assembly_material_no = t.material_code
ORDER BY p.production_order_no, p.assembly_material_no ) t WHERE ROWNUM <= (#{pageNo} * #{pageSize}) ) t2 WHERE t2.rn > ((#{pageNo} - 1) * #{pageSize})

SELECT workshop, COUNT(DISTINCT order_no) AS orderCount, NVL(SUM(quantity), 0) AS planQty, NVL(SUM(completed_quantity), 0) AS completeQty, CASE WHEN SUM(quantity) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(completed_quantity) / SUM(quantity) * 100, 2) END AS completionRate, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN open_order_quantity > 0 THEN order_no END) AS shortageOrders FROM ( SELECT workshop, order_no, MAX(quantity) AS quantity, MAX(completed_quantity) AS completed_quantity, MAX(open_order_quantity) AS open_order_quantity FROM aps_matching_result WHERE deleted = 0
AND schedule_time >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND schedule_time < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND workshop = #{workshop}
AND supplier_name = #{supplier}
AND create_time >= (SELECT TRUNC(MAX(create_time)) FROM aps_matching_result WHERE deleted = 0) AND create_time < (SELECT TRUNC(MAX(create_time)) + 1 FROM aps_matching_result WHERE deleted = 0)
GROUP BY workshop, order_no ) GROUP BY workshop ORDER BY workshop

SELECT supplier_name AS supplier, COUNT(DISTINCT purchase_order) AS openOrderCount, NVL(SUM(open_order_quantity), 0) AS openQty, COUNT(DISTINCT component_code) AS affectedParts, COUNT(DISTINCT order_no) AS affectedOrders FROM aps_matching_result WHERE deleted = 0 AND supplier_name IS NOT NULL
AND schedule_time >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND schedule_time < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND workshop = #{workshop}
AND supplier_name = #{supplier}
AND create_time >= (SELECT TRUNC(MAX(create_time)) FROM aps_matching_result WHERE deleted = 0) AND create_time < (SELECT TRUNC(MAX(create_time)) + 1 FROM aps_matching_result WHERE deleted = 0)
GROUP BY supplier_name HAVING SUM(open_order_quantity) > 0 ORDER BY openQty DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT purchase_material AS componentCode, purchase_material_desc AS componentDesc, NVL(SUM(OPEN_ORDER_QUANTITY), 0) AS shortageQty, COUNT(DISTINCT order_no) AS affectedOrders FROM aps_matching_result WHERE deleted = 0 AND OPEN_ORDER_QUANTITY > 0
AND schedule_time >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND schedule_time < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND workshop = #{workshop}
AND supplier_name = #{supplier}
AND create_time >= (SELECT TRUNC(MAX(create_time)) FROM aps_matching_result WHERE deleted = 0) AND create_time < (SELECT TRUNC(MAX(create_time)) + 1 FROM aps_matching_result WHERE deleted = 0)
GROUP BY purchase_material, purchase_material_desc ORDER BY NVL(SUM(OPEN_ORDER_QUANTITY), 0) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT t.*, ROWNUM AS rn FROM ( SELECT b.order_no AS orderNo, MAX(b.material_Code) AS materialCode, MAX(b.material_desc) AS materialDesc, MAX(b.workshop) AS workshop, MAX(b.schedule_time) AS scheduleTime, MAX(b.quantity) AS quantity, MAX(b.TOTAL_QTY) as totalQty, MAX(b.completed_quantity) AS completedQuantity, MAX(b.transfer_order) AS transferOrder, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.open_order_quantity > 0 THEN b.purchase_material END) AS shortageCount, (SELECT WM_CONCAT(w2.component_desc) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT w.order_no, w.purchase_material_desc AS component_desc FROM aps_matching_result w WHERE w.open_order_quantity > 0 AND w.deleted = 0
AND w.schedule_time >= TO_DATE(#{req.startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND w.schedule_time < TO_DATE(#{req.endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') + 1
AND w.workshop = #{req.workshop}
AND w.supplier_name = #{req.supplier}
AND w.order_no IN (SELECT DISTINCT order_no FROM aps_matching_result WHERE purchase_material = #{req.materialCode} OR material_code = #{req.materialCode})
AND w.create_time >= (SELECT TRUNC(MAX(create_time)) FROM aps_matching_result WHERE deleted = 0) AND w.create_time < (SELECT TRUNC(MAX(create_time)) + 1 FROM aps_matching_result WHERE deleted = 0)
) w2 WHERE w2.order_no = b.order_no ) AS warning FROM aps_matching_result b WHERE b.deleted = 0
AND b.schedule_time >= TO_DATE(#{req.startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND b.schedule_time < TO_DATE(#{req.endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') + 1
AND b.workshop = #{req.workshop}
AND b.supplier_name = #{req.supplier}
AND b.order_no IN (SELECT DISTINCT order_no FROM aps_matching_result WHERE purchase_material = #{req.materialCode} OR material_code = #{req.materialCode} )
AND b.create_time >= (SELECT TRUNC(MAX(create_time)) FROM aps_matching_result WHERE deleted = 0) AND b.create_time < (SELECT TRUNC(MAX(create_time)) + 1 FROM aps_matching_result WHERE deleted = 0)
GROUP BY b.order_no
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN b.open_order_quantity > 0 THEN 1 END) > 0
ORDER BY MAX(b.schedule_time), MAX(b.workshop), b.order_no ) t WHERE ROWNUM <= (#{req.pageNo} * #{req.pageSize}) ) t2 WHERE t2.rn > ((#{req.pageNo} - 1) * #{req.pageSize}) ORDER BY scheduleTime,workshop,orderNo

SELECT purchase_material AS componentCode, purchase_material_desc AS componentDesc, PURCHASE_REQUIRED_QTY AS requiredQty, OPEN_ORDER_QUANTITY AS shortage, TO_CHAR(basic_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS expectedDate, DELIVERED_QUANTITY + to_deliver_quantity AS inTransit, schedule_time AS scheduleTime FROM aps_matching_result WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND OPEN_ORDER_QUANTITY > 0 AND deleted = 0
AND create_time >= (SELECT TRUNC(MAX(create_time)) FROM aps_matching_result WHERE deleted = 0) AND create_time < (SELECT TRUNC(MAX(create_time)) + 1 FROM aps_matching_result WHERE deleted = 0)
ORDER BY purchase_material

SELECT purchase_order AS purchaseOrder, supplier_name AS supplier, order_date AS orderDate, required_delivery_date AS requiredDate, purchase_required_qty AS orderQty, delivered_quantity AS receivedQty, open_order_quantity AS openQty FROM aps_matching_result WHERE purchase_material = #{componentCode} AND order_no = #{orderNo} AND purchase_order IS NOT NULL AND deleted = 0
AND create_time >= (SELECT TRUNC(MAX(create_time)) FROM aps_matching_result WHERE deleted = 0) AND create_time < (SELECT TRUNC(MAX(create_time)) + 1 FROM aps_matching_result WHERE deleted = 0)
ORDER BY order_date
